ownerContacts.source: Parent relayed explicit owner answer; not independent delivery or phone verification.

ownerPolicy.email: normal progress, checkpoints, warnings and completion
ownerPolicy.sms: only if primary email delivery fails or cannot be confirmed; no routine duplicate SMS
ownerPolicy.humanRecovery: Owner checks while awake. Overnight cleanup must not depend on response.

verifiedPublicFacts: Cloud Monitoring supports email and SMS channels. SMS requires phone verification, is not fully reliable, and may be unavailable in some regions.
An alert policy sends to every selected notification channel. Per-channel strategy is renotification interval, not sequential failover.

Official notification troubleshooting exposes failure logs. No documented positive email-to-recipient delivery receipt or email-first conditional SMS policy is available in the reviewed native API. Absence of an error is not a delivery receipt.
Native alerting is event/incident notification; routine arbitrary progress/completion email is not an implemented capability of the existing Pub/Sub-only controller.

Official pricing lists no separate native SMS notification fee. Alert-policy billing begins no sooner than September 1, 2027; published data/API/logging costs still apply. No carrier-price or delivery guarantee follows from this.
proposedMinimalDecision: Keep ordinary notifications email-only and keep this initial phase attended; require explicit owner approval for manual receipt confirmation/fallback or a narrowly specified receipt-aware delivery service. Do not attach SMS directly to every Monitoring policy. This proposal does not itself satisfy automatic conditional failover, and must not be labelled ready.

smallestConsequentialAlternatives.option: Explicit exception for critical safety incidents only
smallestConsequentialAlternatives.change: Allow email plus SMS fan-out for watchdog failure, scheduler silence and incomplete cleanup while keeping routine progress email-only. This is simpler and avoids a new relay, but changes owner condition and requires explicit agreement.

Approve a bounded delivery relay or established escalation provider, define recipient delivery/acknowledgment evidence and timeout, fail over only on explicit failure or expiry. Additional source, credentials/service, costs and independent proof are required; not silently included in this task.

implementationBlockers: Existing render_provider_descriptors.py requires at least two distinct native channel resource names. Do not silently weaken it or supply duplicate channels as fake redundancy.
No actual email channel, verified SMS channel, numeric channel ID, subscription/forwarder, notification send, delivery proof or conditional relay exists.
No unattended or overnight execution until real independent automatic cleanup (including absence/remaining liabilities) is demonstrated; alert delivery alone is insufficient.

costProposal.interpretation: No separately published Google SMS line item, not an assertion of guaranteed free carrier delivery. Existing $3 alerts/logs/API uncertainty allocation retained.
costProposal.relayCostStatus: Unselected and unapproved; cannot quote zero.
